means.example-sentence: Tom was in such a hurry to get to the airport that he left without the gift from us.
means.sentence-jp: トムは空港に行くのにとても急いでいたので, 私たちからの贈り物を忘れていった。

cloze.maskedText: Tom was ____ to get to the airport that he left without the gift from us.

notes: 『急げ』と人をせかす表現は, Hurry up. や Step on it [the gas]. など。
hurry ~ up は「〜を急がせる」。
